summary: Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that Trustee and CIO Mario J. Gabelli was hospitalized after a medical incident on March 19, 2026, and his return timeline is unknown. The fund's adviser parent GAMCO implemented its succession plan, naming Christopher J. Marangi President on March 22, 2026. Day-to-day operations continue under co-CEOs Douglas R. Jamieson and Marangi, with portfolio management led by co-CIOs Kevin V. Dreyer and Marangi. This is a forced leadership transition due to medical absence. Watch for updates on Gabelli's health and potential permanent succession.
